criteria-objective.reason: RE-EVALUATED 2026-08-28 after a thirty-third criterion was added, and re-attested rather than carried forward — the same regression this criterion took on 2026-08-27, handled the same way. ⚠️ ACC-0036 IS OBJECTIVE, and each of its clauses is a string test against a served response: the document region contains an error, the error contains a repository-relative path, it contains a line and column, the diagnostic's markup characters appear escaped, and the exit-criteria markers are still present. The failing cases are equally mechanical — a region containing only a digest, or containing nothing. ⚠️ IT IS ALSO THE FIRST CRITERION IN THIS STAGE WRITTEN FROM A PRODUCTION MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN FROM A DESIGN. AST-0039 measured that a refused document reaches the browser as HTTP 200 and an opaque digest, so this criterion is not a precaution against something imaginable — it is the specification of a behaviour that was observed to be wrong. ⚠️ ONE JUDGEMENT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: 'visible' is operationalised as 'present in the served response body, inside the document region'. That is a proxy for what a human sees, in the same way AC-9's provenance clause was handled in run 1 — a strong proxy, and still a proxy. A region that renders the text in white-on-white would satisfy the letter of it. ⚠️ Run 1 (ACC-0001..ACC-0012) and run 2 (ACC-0013..ACC-0035) are unchanged. Every criterion for CMP-0012..CMP-0020 that has been evaluated was evaluated by a falsified test; the rest remain `not-evaluated`, which is this stage saying what it does not yet know.
